g.text: The four arms with a table are slightly too narrow, by up to 2.4 points

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of observed values at or below each forecast quantile, minus the quantile level, scored year, five decision substations, rows outside the switching events. Zero is perfect calibration; above zero at low levels and below zero at high levels means the band is too narrow. Arm MO (members only) is left out because its gaps reach 36 points.'
text.tspan: Share of observed values at or below each forecast quantile, minus the quantile level, scored year,
five decision substations, rows outside the switching events. Zero is perfect calibration; above
zero at low levels and below zero at high levels means the band is too narrow. Arm MO (members only)
is left out because its gaps reach 36 points.
